jobs.title: Directeur(trice) de l’analytique marketing / Director of Marketing Analytics
jobs.description:
Brief Description

Qui est Manmade?

Nous sommes un détaillant en ligne de produits essentiels de première qualité basé à Montréal, connu particulièrement jusqu'à présent pour nos boxer pour hommes. Nous avons connu une croissance rapide depuis notre lancement en 2021, et la marque est véritablement à un tournant pour devenir un nom familier au Canada, et elle se développe déjà en parallèle sur le marché américain.

Qui recherchons-nous?

Nous recherchons un(e) Chef(fe) de l’analytique marketing
pour bâtir et diriger la fonction d’analytique marketing de Manmade.

Vous serez responsable de la façon dont nous mesurons et interprétons la performance marketing, en regroupant les données de nos différents canaux pour offrir une vision claire et fiable des facteurs qui contribuent aux résultats de l’entreprise. Une priorité sera de créer une source de référence unique et centralisée
pour la performance marketing et de mettre en place les tableaux de bord, les indicateurs clés de performance et les cadres de mesure qui guideront les décisions de nos équipes.

Il s’agit d’un poste de niveau senior avec une forte implication opérationnelle
. Vous devrez explorer les données, créer des tableaux de bord, analyser la performance et résoudre vous-même les problèmes, tout en établissant les bases d’une équipe et d’une fonction capables d’évoluer avec Manmade.

Si vous aimez transformer des données complexes en décisions d’affaires claires et souhaitez bâtir une fonction à partir de zéro, nous aimerions vous rencontrer.

Ce poste est-il fait pour vous ?

Nous nous développons rapidement, les choses changent vite et une présence en interne est nécessaire.

Ce que nous offrons?
Nous pensons qu'un travail de qualité commence par un environnement de qualité. En tant que membre de notre équipe, vous bénéficierez de déjeuners quotidiens gratuits, de collations et de boissons pour vous permettre de rester en forme et concentré. Nous offrons une assurance de groupe payée à 100 %, des salaires compétitifs qui sont révisés régulièrement avec des augmentations annuelles garanties, et une structure de primes de partage des bénéfices pour que tout le monde participe à notre succès.

Nous sommes dans une phase de croissance, ce qui signifie de réelles opportunités pour vous d'apprendre, de vous développer et de faire passer votre carrière au niveau supérieur. Avant tout, vous ferez partie d'une culture amusante, innovante et respectueuse où vos idées sont valorisées et où votre impact est réel.

Responsabilités

Bâtir et prendre en charge la fonction d’analytique et de mesure marketing de Manmade, tant pour l’acquisition que pour la fidélisation de la clientèle.
Créer une source de référence unique pour la performance marketing en regroupant les données de Meta, Google, TikTok, du marketing par courriel, du marketing d’influence, de Shopify et de l’analytique Web.
Concevoir et maintenir des tableaux de bord, des cadres d’indicateurs clés de performance et des rapports offrant aux équipes Marketing et à la direction une vision claire de la performance.
Analyser les indicateurs clés, notamment le coût d’acquisition client (CAC), la valeur vie client (LTV), le rendement des dépenses publicitaires (ROAS), le ratio d’efficacité marketing (MER), la rétention, la conversion, les cohortes de clients et la performance des canaux.
Collaborer avec les équipes Marketing et Finance pour relier les investissements et la performance marketing aux revenus, à la rentabilité par client et à une croissance rentable.
Évaluer la performance des canaux, des campagnes, des audiences et des créations publicitaires, puis traduire les résultats en recommandations claires et concrètes.
Développer l’approche de Manmade en matière d’attribution, d’incrémentalité, d’expérimentation et de mesure marketing, notamment au moyen de tests A/B, de tests géographiques et de groupes témoins.
Consolider et valider les données provenant des différentes plateformes afin de garantir l’exactitude et la fiabilité des rapports.
Mener des analyses approfondies pour répondre à des questions d’affaires complexes et repérer des occasions d’amélioration en matière d’acquisition, de fidélisation et de valeur vie client.
Mettre en place des processus, des outils et une infrastructure analytiques capables de soutenir la croissance, et définir la feuille de route de la fonction.
Maintenir une forte implication opérationnelle tout en bâtissant et en dirigeant, à terme, une équipe d’analytique marketing performante.

Éxigences

De 7 à 10 ans d’expérience progressive en analytique marketing, en analytique de croissance, en intelligence d’affaires, en analyse de données ou dans un domaine connexe.
Solide expérience en commerce électronique, en vente directe aux consommateurs (DTC), dans le secteur des produits de consommation ou au sein d’une autre entreprise numérique à forte croissance.
Expérience démontrée dans la création ou le développement d’une fonction d’analytique marketing, notamment les tableaux de bord, les cadres d’indicateurs clés de performance, les rapports et les processus de mesure.
Maîtrise avancée de SQL et d’Excel, ainsi qu’une solide expérience avec des outils d’intelligence d’affaires comme Looker, Tableau, Power BI ou des outils similaires.
Expérience avec Shopify, GA4, Meta, Google, TikTok et d’autres plateformes de marketing numérique.
Compréhension approfondie du CAC, de la LTV, du ROAS, du MER, de la rétention, de la conversion, de l’analyse de cohortes, de l’attribution et de la rentabilité par client.
Expérience en expérimentation marketing et en mesure de l’incrémentalité, notamment les tests A/B, les tests géographiques et les groupes témoins.
Solide sens des affaires et capacité à relier la performance marketing aux résultats commerciaux et financiers de l’entreprise.
Capacité à définir la stratégie analytique tout en explorant personnellement les données et en développant des solutions.
Excellentes aptitudes en communication et capacité à traduire des données complexes en constats clairs pour les équipes Marketing, Finance et la direction.
Une expérience dans la constitution d’équipes, le mentorat ou la gestion de professionnels en analytique est fortement souhaitée.
Baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.

Who is Manmade?

We’re a Montreal-based online retailer of premium quality essentials, known particularly so far for our men’s boxer briefs. We have been rapidly growing since launching in 2021, and the brand is truly at a turning point to becoming a household name in Canada, and already growing rapidly in parallel in the US market.

Who is Manmade looking for?

We’re looking for a Head of Marketing Analytics
to build and lead Manmade’s marketing analytics function.

You’ll own how we measure and understand marketing performance, bringing together data across our channels to create a clear, trusted view of what’s driving the business. A key priority will be building a unified source of truth
for marketing performance and establishing the dashboards, KPIs, and measurement frameworks our teams use to make decisions.

This is a senior but deeply hands-on role
. You’ll be expected to dig into the data, build dashboards, analyze performance, and solve problems yourself while creating the foundation for a team and function that can scale with Manmade.

If you love turning complex data into clear business decisions and want the opportunity to build something from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you.

Is this for you?

We are growing so rapidly so things are changing so quickly and an in-house presence is required

What are we offering?
Aside from a competitive compensation package, the opportunity in itself is what you make of it. With the company growing 250%+ year over year for the past 3 years, and with expected growth to continue at a high pace for the next 2-3 years, there will be many different ways to grow within the company as it enters new markets, channels, and so on.

We offer extended health and dental benefits, 100% fully paid by the employer. We offer catered lunches every day and all the snacks, drinks, coffee, and fruit you could want.

Responsibilities

Own and build Manmade’s marketing analytics and measurement function across customer acquisition and retention.
Create a unified source of truth for marketing performance across Meta, Google, TikTok, Email, Influencer, Shopify, and web analytics.
Build and maintain dashboards, KPI frameworks, and reporting that give Marketing and leadership a clear view of performance.
Analyze key metrics including CAC, LTV, ROAS, MER, retention, conversion, customer cohorts, and channel performance.
Partner with Marketing and Finance to connect marketing investment and performance to revenue, customer economics, and profitable growth.
Evaluate channel, campaign, audience, and creative performance and turn findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Develop Manmade’s approach to attribution, incrementality, experimentation, and marketing measurement, including A/B tests, geo studies, and holdouts.
Consolidate and validate data across platforms, ensuring reporting is accurate, reliable, and trusted.
Conduct deep-dive analyses to answer complex business questions and identify opportunities across acquisition, retention, and customer lifetime value.
Build scalable analytics processes, tools, and infrastructure, and establish the roadmap for the function as Manmade grows.
Remain deeply hands-on while eventually building and leading a high-performing marketing analytics team.

Qualifications

7–10 years of progressive experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, or a related field.
Strong experience in e-commerce, DTC, consumer, or another high-growth digital business.
Proven experience building or scaling a marketing analytics function, including dashboards, KPI frameworks, reporting, and measurement processes.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and Excel, with strong experience in BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Experience with Shopify, GA4, Meta, Google, TikTok, and other digital marketing platforms.
Deep understanding of CAC, LTV, ROAS, MER, retention, conversion, cohort analysis, attribution, and customer economics.
Experience with marketing experimentation and incrementality, including A/B testing, geo testing, and holdouts.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to connect marketing performance to broader business and financial outcomes.
Ability to operate at both levels: setting analytics strategy while personally digging into the data and building solutions.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights for Marketing, Finance, and leadership.
Experience building, mentoring, or leading analytics talent is strongly preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience.

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Director, Equipment Planning and Biomedical Services is accountable for clinical and non-clinical asset planning, maintenance and management. The role provides overall leadership to Mackenzie Health equipment needs for short-term and long-term asset planning, tracking, maintenance, management, and refresh. The director is responsible for overseeing all facility and redevelopment work required to plan, procure, and complete installation of medical equipment. This role also provides Director-level leadership to the Central Equipment and Biomedical Engineering departments. This role works within an environment that has Design-Build-Finance-Maintain (DBFP) equipment relationships, Managed Equipment Services (MES) contract, as well as a traditional in-house biomedical engineering service and support model. This role also works closely with Mackenzie Health Redevelopment department to plan, procure, and implement the Furniture, Fixtures, and Equipment (FF&E) components of various redevelopment projects. Additionally, the Director coordinates efforts with various departments to develop and maintain a multi-year equipment plan and budget, ensuring appropriate inventory levels, mitigation of corporate risk, and balances demand with broader organizational need.

Primary Responsibilities

Maintain current knowledge of laws, ordinances, and regulations pertaining to corporate purchasing practices.
Working in close collaboration with corporate procurement, develop a multi year clinical technology strategy, in conjunction with clinical and nonclinical leaders, and that aligns with organizational priorities. The strategy must include centralized purchasing/procurement of materials, equipment, machinery, and services required for operations, projects, and capital investments.
Responsible for the implementation of all Equipment projects from needs identification through to commissioning and on-going maintenance.
Manage and oversee all aspects of large-scale equipment installation projects including managing internal and external stakeholders, shop drawing reviews, scope of work development, project schedule development, budget management, reporting, commissioning, training, and close-out documentation.
Work collaboratively with the Digital Health portfolio to ensure all required integrations are planned and implemented to support equipment use.
Provide executive leadership with strategic and tactical advice, as well as risks and opportunities related to emerging healthcare technologies and long-term organizational planning.
Provide advice to management at all levels by using knowledge of equipment market and procurement.
Working in close collaboration with corporate procurement, supervise or manage complex negotiations to settle commercial disputes and claims with suppliers by establishing goals and approving commercial settlements.
Manage the Philips MESP contract ($300M+ over 14-year contract life) and provide support to Philips and the Mackenzie Clinical team in the administration of the MESP contracted services.
Provide direct leadership to Biomedical Engineering and Central Equipment staff and services across a multi site hospital system.
Establish policies and procedures supporting safe equipment use and maintenance.
Lead service contract procurement and negotiations.
Monitor vendor performance and service level agreements.
Develop performance KPI for adequate service and support of medical equipment.
Work with multiple equipment vendors to coordinate design and construction activities, monitor performance and intervene to rectify issues.
Ensure the development and maintenance of work systems, goals and objectives, management systems, teamwork, and resource management for departments within the area of accountability.
Create and maintain asset management and tracking workflows and processes.
Create and maintain a space management program.
Space management includes oversight and recommendations to resolve all space requests. Working collaboratively with Redevelopment, Facilities, Clinical, Clinical Support Teams to ensure space allocations are prioritized and allocated based on hospital priorities.
Act as Chair of the Change Request Group (SAFES) to ensure alignment with corporate vision and mission.
Manage the intake, review, and implementation of all changes related to Space, Aesthetics, Furniture, Equipment, and Signage.
Provide leadership, support, and direction to program staff on issues related to performance, corporate direction, service delivery, staff development, Human Resources Management (HRM), realignment, and change management strategies.
Direct the process of establishing, implementing, and reporting on appropriate quality and productivity indicator measurement tools, based on provincial benchmarks, best practice standards, and legislative requirements.
Co-develop annual budgets and operating plans that align with the hospital’s programs and directives, and ensure the program stays within budget.
Ensure all assigned employees comply with hospital, government, and customer policies, procedures, and regulations.
Build external and internal business relationships to gather information, identify market and industry trends, build partnership and alliances to support and facilitate the hospital’s objectives and plans.
Management of Regulatory Requirements as applicable to equipment installations ensuring all documentation is submitted and approved by appropriate regulatory bodies to support the installation and use of medical equipment (e.g. HARP, CNSC).
Ensure effective procurement activities that meet the requirements and needs of the hospital’s internal stakeholders.
Ensure a safe environment for patients, staff, and visitors; investigate, report, debrief and take or direct corrective action as appropriate on incidents.
Manage human resources which include recruitment, selection and training.
Teach, coach and lead staff in the development and monitoring of quality indicators and improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders/organizations/community groups to achieve program objectives, integrate, and link services and foster partnerships across the continuum of service delivery.
Participate in education and training specific to current, relevant federal and provincial health and safety legislation, standards, and guidelines.

What must you have?

Minimum of a Master’s Degree or Master’s ready in Business, Economics, or in a related field, from an accredited university.
Minimum of 5-10 years experience working in equipment planning and procurement within a health care environment.
Minimum of five (5) years’ working in a senior leadership role, preferably in a health care environment.
Biomedical service leadership experience is required or similar experience that is deemed equivalent.
Training or recent experience with drafting requests for proposals and vendor agreements is required.

What else do you bring?

Strong knowledge of hospital operations.
Demonstrated experience in negotiating and managing large, complex contracts.
Demonstrated knowledge of the appropriate tools for grading, analyzing, and assessing materials, equipment, supplies, services, and other commodities.
Demonstrated knowledge of Supply Chain Management (SCM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and Material Requirements Planning (MRP) software.
Demonstrated excellent critical and logical thinking, analysis, and reasoning to identify underlying principles, reasons, or facts.
Demonstrated project management, change management, and analytical thinking skills.
Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and influence individuals and teams toward a vision, while maintaining group cohesiveness and effectiveness.
Demonstrated strategic business sense with financial management and budget development skills.
Demonstrated understanding of interrelationships between clinical and support programs.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex systems and human resources at the executive level.
Demonstrated leadership skills with ability to foster relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to coach, advise and teach others using the principles of adult learning.
Demonstrated training, experience, or utilization of lean methodology for process improvement.
Demonstrated ability to independently identify issues, plan improvements, measure success and continue improvement.
Proven attendance record.
Demonstrates understanding and complies with patient and staff safety policies and procedures that foster a safe and inclusive environment for all.
Ability to perform the essential duties of the job.
Effectively uses empathy in interactions with others.
Demonstrates behaviours consistent with Mackenzie Health’s Commitment to Caring.
Models behaviour that is aligned with the values of Mackenzie Health – Excellence, Leadership and Empathy.
Commitment to providing an exceptional experience for staff and clients within a challenging and exciting health care environment.

Prepare and review technical accounting memos, position papers, and supporting documentation.
Support accounting matters involving areas such as revenue recognition, leases, business combinations, foreign currency, impairment, and other complex transactions, as applicable.

Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and reconciliation activities.
Strengthen reporting processes, systems, and controls as the organization grows and reporting requirements evolve.

CPA designation.

Develop, lead, and manage core FP&A activities.

Lead the development of scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis and risks & opportunities.

Oversee capex financial management and capex forecasting improvement initiatives.
Lead inventory financial management and work with key stakeholders to optimize the level of inventory.
Oversee the preparation of the International Division monthly management accounts, FP&A reports and dashboards, including presentations to SLT and the company’s Board of Directors.
Support the division’s Senior Leadership Team (SLT) to evaluate and review new business and investment opportunities, including new business pricing, client Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), Return on Investment (ROI), payback period and return on capital (RONA) analyses.
Support the executive team decision-making by providing insightful data and analysis with the objective of improving Top Aces’ profitability and efficiency.
Build and develop the skill sets of finance professionals under her/his direction.

Significant expertise with data analysis and reporting.

new_jobs.title: Director, Financial Planning & Analysis and Capital Investment - International Division
new_jobs.description:
Founded in 2000 by three former Royal Canadian Air Force (RCAF) CF-18 fighter pilots who identified an opportunity to improve military readiness training, Top Aces has since established itself as the world leader in contracted adversary air (ADAIR) services and joint terminal attack controller (JTAC) training.

We pride ourselves on our unblemished safety record, having flown an industry leading 130,000+ hours of operational training without accident in support of customers worldwide, including Canada, the U.S., Germany, and multiple other NATO allies and international partner nations.

Our vision is to be the most trusted provider of innovative defense training solutions, continuously elevating standards in an industry where "Experience Matters." This commitment to innovation and technology ensures we remain adaptable, training allied militaries to succeed against evolving threats.

Top Aces’ dynamic team contributes to delivering on our purpose of training the next generation of combat leaders by living our values of Service, Integrity, Excellence, and Together every day!

Join our team!

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Director FP&A and Capital Investment is a key member of the company’s finance team and is responsible for supporting all financial planning and analysis activities across the International Division of Top Aces Inc. The director will be responsible for the division’s annual budget process, financial forecasting, financial strategic planning and business performance analysis activities. Additionally, the director will be responsible for supporting the effort to enhance the company’s continuous improvement initiatives aimed at improving profitability and efficiency. The director will provide project financial support, return on investment (ROI) analysis along with KPI development, measurement and analysis. The successful candidate will have demonstrable leadership competencies, strong attention to detail, and will work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment. The candidate will demonstrate a successful track record of working collaboratively in a dynamic environment and a matrix organizational structure.

Own the division’s annual budgeting and financial planning process (quarterly forecasts and strategic plan 5-year forecast) and review all associated financial plans and budgets.
Develop, lead, and manage core FP&A activities.
Lead the development of P&L, balance sheet and cash flow forecasts and partner with internal stakeholders to optimize working capital (prepayments, inventory) and cash flow generation.
Lead the development of scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis and risks & opportunities.

Oversee capex financial management and capex forecasting improvement initiatives.
Lead inventory financial management and work with key stakeholders to optimize the level of inventory.
Oversee the preparation of the International Division monthly management accounts, FP&A reports and dashboards, including presentations to SLT and the company’s Board of Directors.
Support the division’s Senior Leadership Team (SLT) to evaluate and review new business and investment opportunities, including new business pricing, client Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), Return on Investment (ROI), payback period and return on capital (RONA) analyses.
Support the executive team decision-making by providing insightful data and analysis with the objective of improving Top Aces’ profitability and efficiency.
Build and develop the skill sets of finance professionals under her/his direction.

Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree required with concentration in finance and/or accounting or comparable business field preferred.
CPA and/or MBA preferred
10-15 years of experience in relevant accounting, or financial leadership roles.
Significant expertise with data analysis and reporting.
Ability to handle multiple assignments on a timely basis with a high degree of accuracy.
High level of motivation and aptitude for problem solving, with a strong attention to detail.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills as well as strategic thinking to effectively interface with external stakeholders and the division’s Senior Leadership Team.
Ability to translate financial data into strategic insights.
Able to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines, possessing a high sense of urgency.
Ability to perform all work in support of our Corporate Values of Excellence, Service, Integrity … Together.

Working Conditions:

May be required to travel from time to time
May be required to work overtime or longer hours when Top Aces Requires

Supervisory, Training and Advisory Responsibilities:

May be required to provide regular guidance, advice and training, as requested by the supervisor, to other employees supporting the function.

Occupational Health and Safety:

Employees are responsible for:

Working in compliance with Occupational Health and Safety acts and regulations
Following safe work practices and procedures and using safeguards and personal protective equipment
Reporting hazards (such as unsafe situations and activities) to their supervisor immediately.

Security Clearance Requirements/ CGP / ITAR:

Position requires Level II clearance with the Canadian Government and the ability to gain access to the Canadian Controlled Goods Program

By joining Top Aces, you will find:

A work environment in which service, integrity, excellence and teamwork are highly valued;
Opportunities for development and growth;
Multidisciplinary and multicultural collaboration at a local and global level;
A flexible schedule;
Attractive benefit plan.

Come share your passion with us! Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered, and challenged to be your best self.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Top Aces, all employees are welcome regardless of race, nationality, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability or age. The masculine form may be used in this job description solely for ease of reading but refers to men, women and gender diversity.
